stress_anxiety.name: Stress & Overwhelm
stress_anxiety.description: Measures acute tension, cognitive overload, and perceived inability to manage current demands.

emotional_wellbeing.name: Emotional Resilience
emotional_wellbeing.description: Assesses emotional regulation, baseline mood stability, optimism, and inner fortitude.

energy_vitality.name: Vitality & Focus
energy_vitality.description: Measures physical energy, restorative sleep, concentration stamina, and daily motivation.

coping_adaptability.name: Coping Adaptability
coping_adaptability.description: Evaluates the use of proactive, problem-solving, and constructive coping mechanisms vs avoidant habits.

social_connectivity.name: Social Anchoring
social_connectivity.description: Gauges perceived social support, communication with peers/family, and feelings of belonging.

personas.title: The Resilient Anchor
personas.tagline: High Emotional Balance & Strong Proactive Coping
personas.summary: You demonstrate exceptional emotional fortitude, steady vitality, and healthy coping mechanisms. You maintain healthy boundaries under pressure and serve as a stabilizing presence for those around you.

personas.title: The High-Functioning Overachiever
personas.tagline: Elevated Drive with Hidden Fatigue & Emerging Overwhelm
personas.summary: You possess strong drive and capability, but your nervous system is carrying a significant accumulated load. High cognitive demands paired with insufficient restorative recovery are pushing you toward burnout.

personas.title: The Overwhelmed Navigator
personas.tagline: Elevated Stress & Acute Overload in Transition
personas.summary: You are currently experiencing heightened psychological strain and cognitive overload. Everyday stressors feel magnified, making immediate nervous system regulation and restorative micro-habits essential.

personas.title: The Depleted Explorer
personas.summary: Your vitality reserves are currently running on empty. Disrupted sleep, routine fatigue, or sustained mental exertion have depleted your physical stamina and emotional spark.

personas.title: The Balanced Harmonizer
personas.summary: You are navigating daily demands with a moderate degree of stability. While your emotional and stress baselines are manageable, introducing structured wellness rituals will amplify your focus and resilience.

stress_anxiety.detail: Perform 3 minutes of double-inhalation followed by extended exhalation to down-regulate acute sympathetic nervous arousal.
Externalize mental chatter onto paper each evening. Categorize demands into actionable vs uncontrollable buckets to curb bedtime rumination.
Enforce a screen-free window 45 minutes prior to sleep to prevent circadian disruption and nocturnal stress spikes.

energy_vitality.detail: Expose eyes to natural outdoor light for 10-15 minutes within 30 minutes of waking and drink 500ml water to anchor circadian alertness.
Work in 90-minute focused blocks followed by mandatory 10-minute active non-screen restoration (stretching, pacing, breathing).
Optimize sleep environment (temperature ~19°C/66°F, blackout curtains, white noise) to maximize restorative delta-wave sleep.

emotional_wellbeing.detail: Identify three distinct moments of comfort or accomplishment from today, mentally acknowledging why they mattered.
Notice self-critical inner dialogues. Intentionally reframe them with empathetic, constructive coaching language.
Dedicate at least 2 hours each weekend to a hobby or creative outlet solely for intrinsic fulfillment, detached from performance.

coping_adaptability.detail: Engage your five senses to ground your mind in the present physical space whenever feeling mentally scattered.
When facing complex hurdles, break them into the smallest 15-minute micro-tasks to prevent paralysis and build momentum.
Schedule active relaxation (nature walks, light yoga, journaling) on your calendar just as you would an academic or work deadline.

social_connectivity.detail: Send a quick supportive text or audio message to a friend or mentor with zero expectation of a prolonged conversation.
Work or study in communal environments (libraries, student lounges, cafes) to experience social presence without social strain.
Maintain a recurring check-in with a trusted confidant where you can honestly share ongoing feelings and mutual support.
